description: Read finite FSM states, events, guards, actions, or transitions. Recipes are structural metadata, not executable runtime code.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for bounded continuation of FSM recipe details.

limit.description: Maximum number of FSM entries to return per page (1-32, default 10).

recipe.description: FSM recipe identifier or alias to retrieve (e.g. "dialog", "tabs", "navigation", "collapsible-navigation", "sidebar").

section.description: Specific FSM recipe contract section to inspect ("states", "events", "guards", "actions", "transitions").

name: get_fsm_recipe
